purpose: Fictional acceptance cases for CI-04; no run/evidence or measured values.

cases.requirement: At least one completed included repetition; raw-linked summaries and non-placeholder provenance; quality threshold outcome recorded separately.
Retain rejection reason and incurred training, witness, proving and verification cost; exclude unaccepted model from released quality.
Retain deadline, elapsed lower bound and partial work; do not report an absent proof or quality value as zero.
No repetitions, measurements or successful proof claim; report the unavailable prerequisite.
No measurements; identify the model/assurance pair and version that is not supported.
Retain executed repetitions and uncertainty; insufficient evidence does not become a successful scientific hypothesis.

accounting_example.purpose: Illustrative cost IDs only; durations are intentionally absent.
accounting_example.total_work_rule: Count setup-1, prove-1 and prove-2 once each; the reuse reference creates no second setup cost. End-to-end wall time is measured separately.
